title: 700亿边境法案：众议院卡在出席率，共和党人急了
speaker: Greg Steube

segments.en: We have the Senate pass this funding for Immigration and Customs Enforcement, Customs and Border Patrol, as well, big package, 70 billion dollars. That's now going to the House. What's your sense of the timing there, and is that ability your intended to support?
segments.zh: 参议院通过了这项为移民和海关执法局、海关和边境巡逻队提供资金的法案，总额700亿美元。现在将提交众议院。你觉得时机如何？你打算支持吗？

segments.en: Well, yes, I 100% support the House's past four bills to fund all of DHS. It's crazy that we've had to go through reconciliation just to fund CBP and ICE.
segments.zh: 嗯，是的，我百分之百支持众议院过去四项为国土安全部提供资金的法案。我们不得不通过和解程序来为边境巡逻队和移民执法局提供资金，这太疯狂了。

segments.en: I was hopeful that we could vote on that on Friday after it came over, but I guess there wasn't enough time to do that and there were members that were traveling. That's the biggest challenge in the House right now is attendance.
segments.zh: 我曾希望法案提交后能在周五投票，但我想时间不够，而且有些成员在旅行。现在众议院最大的挑战是出席率。

segments.en: You've got several members that are running for the US Senate or governors, and in primary South Carolina is on to Z. You got two members in the House that are running in that race. So attendance becomes a challenge.
segments.zh: 有几位成员正在竞选美国参议员或州长，南卡罗来纳州的初选正在进行。众议院有两位成员参加那场竞选。所以出席率成为一个挑战。

segments.en: I hope we can pass that as soon as we get back next week, either Monday or Tuesday. But obviously the whip operation is gonna have to ensure that we have enough people there to get it out.
segments.zh: 我希望下周回来时能尽快通过，周一或周二。但显然，党鞭需要确保有足够的人到场才能通过。

segments.en: I 100% know it'll pass. We just need to make sure that we have more Republicans present than Democrats. I think that'll pass on a straight-party line vote.
segments.zh: 我百分之百知道它会通过。我们只需要确保出席的共和党人比民主党人多。我认为这将按党派划线投票通过。
